properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 9:55PM CDT until July 31 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Day County in northeastern South Dakota...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. It will take
several hours for all the water from these storms to work through
local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 953 PM CDT, emergency management reported heavy rain in the
warned area due to thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing. Between 4
and 8 inches of rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Roslyn and Pierpont.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 31 at 1:20AM CDT until July 31 at 2:00AM CDT by NWS Topeka KS
properties.description:
SVRTOP

The National Weather Service in Topeka has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Nemaha County in northeastern Kansas...
Northeastern Pottawatomie County in northeastern Kansas...
Northern Jackson County in northeastern Kansas...
Brown County in northeastern Kansas...
Southeastern Marshall County in northeastern Kansas...

* Until 200 AM CDT.

* At 119 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 4 miles south of Du Bois to 4 miles south of
Baileyville to 5 miles north of Blaine, moving east-southeast at
45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Holton, Hiawatha, Sabetha, Seneca, Horton, Frankfort, Onaga,
Centralia, Axtell, Wetmore, Fairview, Morrill, Circleville, Bern,
Corning, Netawaka, Soldier, Havensville, Goff, and Vermillion.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 8:05PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Tilden, Three Rivers...Major
flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 39.2 feet
tomorrow evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 39.0
feet on 10/21/2013.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 11:34PM CDT until July 31 at 2:30AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
FFWFSD

The National Weather Service in Sioux Falls has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Kingsbury County in east central South Dakota...

* Until 230 AM CDT.

* At 1134 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 2 to 3 inches in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
De Smet and Erwin.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 31 at 12:12AM CDT until July 31 at 9:15AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:

* WHERE...Northwestern Big Stone County in west central Minnesota...
Southwestern Traverse County in west central Minnesota...
Northeastern Day County in northeastern South Dakota...
Southeastern Marshall County in northeastern South Dakota...

Bonanza Grove, Lake Traverse, Rainbow Island, Rudebusch Corner
and Big Stone Lake.
